name: Chicken Jerky Strips
short: Single-ingredient chicken breast, slow-dried into chewy strips. The treat every dog in the office asks for by name.

name: Duck & Sweet Potato Bites
short: Soft duck bites wrapped around sweet potato. Gentle on sensitive stomachs, big on smell.

name: Salmon Skin Crisps
short: Crunchy baked salmon skin. Naturally rich in omega-3 for coats that shine in Bangkok humidity.

name: Pork Ear Chews
short: Whole dried pork ears for long, happy chewing sessions. Supervise, as with any chew.

name: Peanut Butter Training Bites
short: Pea-sized, low-calorie bites for training sessions. Unsalted peanut butter, no xylitol, ever.

name: Beef Liver Crunch
short: Freeze-dried beef liver, broken into crunchy pieces. The high-value reward for recall training.

name: Chicken & Rice Fresh Meal
short: Gently cooked chicken, jasmine rice, carrot and pumpkin. Frozen in portions, thaw and serve.

name: Lamb & Pumpkin Fresh Meal
short: Lamb, pumpkin and spinach for dogs that are bored of chicken. Our next batch is cooking now.

name: Bone Broth Topper
short: Slow-simmered chicken bone broth to pour over kibble. Gets picky eaters to finish the bowl.

name: Dental Chew Sticks
short: Ridged sweet-potato sticks that scrub while they chew. Grain-free and gentle.

name: Puppy Starter Bundle
short: Training bites, soft duck bites and a small chicken jerky. Everything a new puppy needs for week one.

name: Big Dog Chew Box
short: Pork ears, dental sticks and a 500 g chicken jerky. For the large and the relentless.

name: Freeze-Dried Chicken Bites
short: Pure chicken breast, freeze-dried so it crumbles over food or works as a treat. Our best-selling cat treat.

name: Tuna Flakes
short: Dried skipjack tuna flakes, the Thai cat classic. Sprinkle a pinch, watch the drama stop.

name: Lickable Chicken Purée
short: Smooth chicken purée in squeeze sachets. Hand-feed it or use it to hide a pill.

name: Salmon Crunchies
short: Baked salmon crunchies the size of a fingernail. Good for scatter-feeding on a rainy afternoon.

name: Shrimp Bites
short: Whole freeze-dried shrimp. Sells out every time we make it.

name: Chicken & Pumpkin Wet Food
short: Shredded chicken in a pumpkin broth. High moisture for cats that do not drink enough.

name: Tuna & Mackerel Wet Food
short: Two fish, no gravy thickeners. The one for cats who only eat fish.

name: Kitten Mousse
short: Extra-smooth chicken mousse for kittens from eight weeks. Next batch ships soon.

name: Catnip Crunch
short: Chicken crunchies baked with Thai-grown catnip. For the evening zoomies.

name: Hairball Helper Treats
short: Chicken treats with psyllium and pumpkin to keep hairballs moving the right way.

name: Picky Eater Sampler
short: Six small packs across our cat range, so you find the one they actually like before buying big.

name: Cat Café Box
short: Freeze-dried chicken, tuna flakes, a purée pack and catnip crunch. The gift box for a cat person.
